content_sections.heading: IGNTU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IGNTU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IGNTU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IGNTU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 16 vacancies are available - 2 for Computer Science, 1 for Tourism Management, 1 for Journalism & Mass Communication, 2 for Biotechnology, 3 for Botany, 1 for Geography, 2 for English & FL, 1 for Hindi, 1 for History, 1 for Social Work, and 1 for Museology.

content_sections.heading: IGNTU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the qualification criteria as per UGC/PCI Norms for the respective posts.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGNTU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Faculty posts at IGNTU?
faq.answer: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University (IGNTU) has announced a total of 16 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions. These positions are available across various departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for IGNTU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty positions at IGNTU ranges from Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly earning of up to Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What are the important dates for the IGNTU Guest Faculty walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled to be held on 10th September 2026 and 11th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on these dates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts is as per the UGC/PCI Norms. Candidates should check the official notification for specific departmental requirements.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IGNTU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IGNTU Guest Faculty recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the IGNTU Guest Faculty walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Indira Gandhi National Tribal University, Amarkantak, Madhya Pradesh, 484887. Candidates should verify the exact reporting location from the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty positions at IGNTU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions at IGNTU involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any state in India are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified educational qualifications and other eligibility criteria mentioned in the official notification.
